sentences.ko: 음, 오늘 밤에 이 연극 같이 보러 갈래 물어보려고 잠깐 들렀어.
sentences.text: Um, I I just stopped by to see if you wanted to see this play tonight.

alts.text: Just dropped by — wanna catch this play tonight?
I simply came by to ask whether you would like to see this play tonight.

sentences.note: **stopped by**는 '지나가다 잠깐 들렀다'는 말로, 친구 집이나 사무실에 불쑥 찾아갔을 때 씁니다. **to see if**는 '~인지 물어보려고'라는 뜻이라, 뭔가를 권하러 왔다고 할 때 그대로 붙여 쓰면 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 좋아, 그냥 하려던 말 해 버릴게.
sentences.text: Okay, I better just say what it is I'm going to say.

alts.text: Alright, I'm just gonna come out and say it.
I think it would be best if I simply said what I came here to say.

sentences.note: **I better just say**는 망설이다가 '에라, 그냥 말할게' 하고 말을 꺼낼 때 씁니다. **what it is I'm going to say**는 '하려던 그 말'을 힘주어 말하는 구어 표현이라 긴장된 고백이나 어려운 얘기 앞에 잘 나옵니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 걔가 지하철역까지 바래다주면서 "우리 또 보자" 그러더라.
sentences.text: He walked me to the subway and said, "We should do this again."

alts.text: Walked me to the train and was like, 'Let's do this again.'
After walking me to the subway station, he told me that we should do this again.

sentences.note: **walked me to**는 '~까지 바래다줬다'는 뜻으로, 데이트나 모임이 끝나고 배웅해 줬을 때 씁니다. **We should do this again**은 만남이 즐거웠을 때 헤어지면서 하는 인사입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 연습으로 한 번 먼저 해 보는 게 어때?
sentences.text: Why don't we start with a practice one?

alts.text: Let's do a practice round first.
Perhaps we should begin with a practice attempt.

sentences.note: **Why don't we**는 '~하는 게 어때?' 하고 부드럽게 제안할 때 씁니다. **a practice one**은 게임이든 발표든 '본 게임 전에 연습 삼아 하나'를 해 보자고 할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 근데 있잖아, 진짜 예쁜 여자들이 완전 별 볼 일 없는 남자랑 다니는 거 꼭 보이더라.
sentences.text: Oh, oh, but you know you always see these really beautiful women with these really nothing guys.

alts.text: Gorgeous women with total nobodies — you see it all the time.
However, one frequently sees very beautiful women with men who are rather unremarkable.

sentences.note: **really nothing guys**는 '별 볼 일 없는 남자'를 가볍게 놀리듯 말하는 표현입니다. **you always see**는 '꼭 그런 거 보이잖아' 하고 흔히 보는 일을 꺼낼 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.text: I have never had such a healthy breakup.

alts.text: Best breakup I've ever had.
This is the healthiest breakup I have ever experienced.

sentences.note: **healthy breakup**은 싸우거나 상처 주지 않고 서로 좋게 헤어졌을 때 쓰는 말이에요. **I have never had such** ~ 는 '이런 ~는 처음이야'라고 놀라움을 말할 때 자주 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 우리도 입양할 때 똑같은 일 겪었어.
sentences.text: We went through the same thing when we were adopting.

alts.text: Same here, we dealt with that too when we adopted.
Our family experienced exactly the same thing during the adoption process.

sentences.note: **went through the same thing**은 힘든 일을 겪는 사람에게 '나도 그거 겪어 봤어'라고 공감할 때 딱 맞는 표현이에요. go through는 '(힘든 일을) 겪다'라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 저기요, 제가 그쪽 질문에 대답할 의무는 없거든요?
sentences.text: Look, I don't have to answer your questions, okay?

alts.text: I don't owe you any answers.
I am not obligated to answer your questions.

sentences.note: 자꾸 캐묻는 사람에게 선을 그을 때 **I don't have to answer**라고 해요. 말 앞의 **Look**은 '이봐요, 잘 들어요' 하고 상대를 멈춰 세우는 느낌이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 누군가의 인생을 그렇게 좌우할 수 있는 힘을 갖는 건 좀 부담스러워.
sentences.text: I'm I'm not comfortable having that kind of power and control over someone's life.

alts.text: That's way too much power over someone's life for me.
I do not feel comfortable having that much control over another person's life.

sentences.note: **not comfortable having** ~ 은 '~하는 게 부담스럽다, 내키지 않는다'라고 부드럽게 거절할 때 써요. 큰 결정을 떠맡기기 싫을 때 자연스러운 말이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 이 얘기는 이제 그만 넘어가고 다 같이 밥이나 맛있게 먹자.
sentences.text: Let's move past this and try to have a nice meal all together.

alts.text: Can we just drop it and enjoy dinner together?
We should put this behind us and try to enjoy a pleasant meal together.

sentences.note: **move past this**는 다툼이나 어색한 일이 있은 뒤 '이제 그만 털고 넘어가자'고 할 때 써요. 가족 모임이나 식사 자리에서 분위기를 수습할 때 딱이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends
